metadata.primary_endpoint: Strict family match on empirical_curve_fit domains only, using AICc-selected best model without tolerance rescue
notes: This suite supersedes the permissive headline logic of the legacy 20-domain script.
The 50-domain expansion is tiered. Do not collapse it into a single blended p-value.
Published exponent and analytic identity domains are secondary evidence, not part of the primary empirical endpoint.
